How Much Room a Person Takes

An average man is about 20″ across the shoulders and 10″ deep at the chest; an average woman is about 17¾″ across. Those numbers come from the U.S. Army ANSUR II survey. The bars below are working space for common pantry moves, set against each layout's narrowest aisle.

Bars marked “est.” are planning estimates built from the body sizes, not code values. The 36″ walkway and 42″/48″ work-aisle figures are NKBA kitchen planning guidelines.

Electrical Plan

Your electrician should confirm against the code edition on your permit. New Jersey adopted UCC 2024 in August 2026; its rule proposal moves the electrical subcode to the 2023 NEC, and work already under permit can generally finish under the prior code (the 2020 NEC). The countertop rules below appear in both editions.

    Assumptions to Confirm

      The Bosch on the Counter

      The 3D Bosch Universal Plus (MUM6N10UC, 500 W, 6.5 qt) uses Bosch’s published base size of 15⅜″ wide × 12 ⁵⁄₁₆″ deep × 7 ¹⁵⁄₁₆″ high (motor base with drive tower) and stands 11″ tall with the bowl and lid on. Its shape follows the product photos: oval motor base with a gray sloped front, speed dial on the right front, drive tower at the right rear, white bowl, splash ring, and clear lid. The blender and the second mixer are generic stand-ins at typical sizes; send the models and I will swap in their real dimensions.

      Sources

      • Lehman’s product listing (11″ tall assembled)

      • NEC 210.52 receptacle summary (pantry small-appliance circuits, 24″ and 20″ rules)
